# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

**Breaking change:** The `name` field on `/v2/users` has been split into `first_name` and `last_name`. Clients reading or writing `name` will need to update to the new fields before upgrading — there is no compatibility shim, so this requires a coordinated migration on your end.

**New:** A `--incremental` flag lets pipelines process only new or changed records since the last run, instead of always doing a full sync.

**Performance:** Parquet writes are approximately 40% faster in this release, thanks to internal improvements in the write path.

We recommend testing against a staging environment before upgrading production pipelines, given the breaking API change to user records.
